morocco-tizi-n-tichka-atlas-crossing.title: Morocco · Tizi n’Tichka Atlas Crossing
morocco-tizi-n-tichka-atlas-crossing.slogan: A 294 km loop out of Taddert fuel
morocco-tizi-n-tichka-atlas-crossing.story: Atlas switchbacks, heat and a proper cultural anchor. Out of Zerkten and back again: 294 km, roughly 5 h 39 in the saddle. It goes by way of Aït Benhaddou and Ouarzazate overnight. The climb of the day is Tizi n’Tichka Pass. It tops out at about 2,250 m. It is a high-mountain day.
